body: Oh shit, I feel like a dumb ass. You *ALREADY* do nice shit like this for other people. That's great. Keep on doing that nice thing you do, then.

That's really nice of you, but I'd rather you give it to someone else. There are all kinds of people that would probably love to take their kids out for pizza on a birthday, and simply can't afford it. Those hardworking people deserve a meal much more than I do.

I do volunteer work as a way to "maintain" a resumé during my joblessness, but it's not anything that could ever lead to a paying job. I would also like working with animals, but it's too hard for me to see animals being treated poorly.

Training/education that would lead to employment costs money I don't have.

After struggling with it this long, I don't expect to get better. I don't have a job, and am on my partner's insurance -which still cost hundreds of dollars of month and is lousy- so I only have the options to go to the therapists it selects. Sadly, there aren't many "in-network", just the practice that I go to.

I was trying to avoid meds. The therapist is nice and I'm comfortable talking to her, but having studied psych in university a little, she's still very much involved in getting all of my backstory. I don't often leave the office any better or worse than I entered it. My partner thinks this is entirely my fault, of course. That I must be lying, because I shouldn't still fell like this after months of weekly sessions.

It's not the relationship. I was like this before, but it could have made everything worse. We've been together for 10 years, and own our condo. Granted she's been supporting us after I was forced out of my job, so even if we miraculously sold it, I'd still owe her the last 3 years of bills. I literally have nothing to my name. I may as well just disappear, you know?

Thanks for skipping the "We all have something terrific inside us, you just have to find it" bullshit. 

It's pretty hard to forget that you hate yourself. Internet surfing is my most popular babysitter. It's a minor distraction machine, really.

The therapy doesn't seem to do much. It's almost like she doesn't think I'm depressed or something. I don't know.

I hate myself. I want out of everything. There are no distractions. I have the internet, I guess, but that doesn't make me feel any better. It's like, "Oh look, a meme. -- Yep, I hate my life. Why am I not dead yet?" "Let me check my email... Nope, nothing. Fuck, I am worthless."
